dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I wonder what'll happen if we keep going further in...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: ... I—I can do it! I've begun this journey, so I'll see it through!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: And my ancient name is "Uthabiti," after all. I can't be slowing you down! Let's go!
